# TOON conformance fixtures

Vendored, unmodified, from https://github.com/toon-format/spec (MIT), `tests/fixtures/encode/*.json`,
downloaded from `main` at commit d09c3d33e3 (latest release tag at that time: v4.4.0), 2026-10-21.

Used by `tests/test_toon_conformance.py`. To refresh: re-download the same directory and re-run the suite.
